You are working inside Orca, a multi-agent IDE. You are a dispatched worker.
Your coordinator's terminal handle is: term_8dc72d05-f483-4118-acac-1d0cbeb701b9
Your task ID is: task_977bfd343d5d

You talk to the coordinator only through the CLI commands below. Do not use
Slack, GitHub comments, or any other channel to reach a human during the run.

=== CLI COMMANDS ===

  # Report the terminal task outcome (REQUIRED exactly once).
  #
  # RULE: --body must be a 3-sentence executive summary (what you did,
  # what you found, what's left). Never send an empty body; the coordinator
  # reads the body first and only opens artifacts if it needs more detail.
  # If you produced a long-form artifact, include its path as
  # payload.reportPath so the coordinator can find it without a file search.
  #
  # RULE: send worker_done exactly once. Use --outcome succeeded when the
  # requested work is done, or replace it with --outcome failed when it is not.
  # Never encode failure only in prose and never silently exit.
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload so a late completion
  # from a failed retry cannot complete the current dispatch.
  orca orchestration send --from term_655a6a9c-8dee-406b-be1c-d23d1238a821 --dispatch-capability dcap_YsM1kQfTtTQfvhPQES8UjYZlmH8RoamyoOKmONjipyk \
    --type worker_done --subject "<short status>" \
    --body "<3-sentence summary: what you did, what you found, what's left>" \
    --task-id task_977bfd343d5d --dispatch-id ctx_b8a7ba0cd87f --outcome succeeded \
    --files-modified "path/a,path/b" \
    --report-path "<optional: path to the full artifact>"

  # BEHAVIOR RULE: send a heartbeat every 5 minutes
  # while actively working on the task. The coordinator uses this to
  # distinguish "still thinking" from "hung / crashed." Skip heartbeats only
  # while blocked inside `check --wait` or `ask` — those calls are
  # themselves liveness signals.
  #
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload: the coordinator
  # attributes the heartbeat to the specific dispatch context, not just
  # the task, so a straggler heartbeat from a previously-failed dispatch
  # cannot mask a hung retry.
  orca orchestration send --from term_655a6a9c-8dee-406b-be1c-d23d1238a821 --dispatch-capability dcap_YsM1kQfTtTQfvhPQES8UjYZlmH8RoamyoOKmONjipyk \
    --type heartbeat --subject "alive" \
    --task-id task_977bfd343d5d --dispatch-id ctx_b8a7ba0cd87f \
    --phase "<short: investigating|implementing|reviewing|waiting>"

  # Ask the coordinator a question and block until it answers.
  #
  # BEHAVIOR RULE #1 (MUST NOT VIOLATE):
  # NEVER use AskUserQuestion; use `orca orchestration ask`.
  # AskUserQuestion opens a local TUI prompt that the
  # coordinator cannot see and cannot answer — your session will hang forever
  # waiting on a human. Every interactive question goes through `ask` below.
  #
  # The `ask` verb durably records a question in this Dispatch's Run and
  # blocks until the coordinator replies, then prints the reply body. If the
  # call times out or disconnects, resume with the returned message ID instead
  # of creating a duplicate question.
  orca orchestration ask --from term_655a6a9c-8dee-406b-be1c-d23d1238a821 --dispatch-capability dcap_YsM1kQfTtTQfvhPQES8UjYZlmH8RoamyoOKmONjipyk \
    --question "<your question>" \
    --options "<optional,comma,separated>" \
    --timeout-ms 600000

  # Escalate a blocker or failure (pre-completion, when you need the
  # coordinator to do something before you can continue):
  orca orchestration send --from term_655a6a9c-8dee-406b-be1c-d23d1238a821 --dispatch-capability dcap_YsM1kQfTtTQfvhPQES8UjYZlmH8RoamyoOKmONjipyk \
    --type escalation --subject "Blocked: <reason>" \
    --body "<details>" \
    --task-id task_977bfd343d5d --dispatch-id ctx_b8a7ba0cd87f

  # Check for messages from the coordinator:
  orca orchestration check --terminal term_655a6a9c-8dee-406b-be1c-d23d1238a821

=== AFTER YOU SEND worker_done ===

worker_done ends your turn for this task. Your dispatched work is complete:
stop, return to an idle prompt, and take no further actions — do NOT start
new or unrelated work, do NOT run a sleep/poll loop, and do NOT keep calling
`orca orchestration check`. The coordinator has already recorded your
completion and expects no further output.

A direct instruction from the user takes precedence over this idle rule.
Treat it as new user-owned work: follow it without coordinator approval or a
fresh Dispatch, and do not send lifecycle messages using the settled task or
Dispatch IDs. Never refuse a direct user request because you were a worker.

Do not exit the shell. Your terminal stays available, and if the
coordinator has more for you it will re-engage this terminal with a fresh
preamble + TASK block, which arrives as new input. Treat that as supervised
work under the new Dispatch; ignore stale follow-ups from the settled task.

=== TASK ===
STRICT READ-ONLY CI follow-up review. Inspect only the latest staged changes in attempt20 OMO: .github/workflows/ci.yml, src/omo/workflow_dispatch.py, tests/test_workflow_dispatch.py beyond commit e0b5c7e/c5d210e. Verify old five-field identity remains readable, partial exact identity remains rejected, exact digest/replay still fail-closed, CI pins both jobs to eCOS merged SHA bc067cbc, and CI-equivalent no-project targeted+dogfood result is 155 passed. Return PASS/BLOCK. Do not edit, stage, commit, tag, push, comment, approve, or mutate workflow/runtime.

艹，收到收尾复审任务，老王我先把心跳挂上，然后定位 attempt20 的 OMO 仓。乖乖，attempts 目录不在根上，老王我找找。找到了，`~/agents/blueprint-exact-capability-binding/attempts/t1-12-waveb-ecos-omo-recovery-20260826-20`。老王我看看 OMO 仓的 git 状态和 staged 变更。三个文件全在 staged 区，干干净净没有 unstaged 残渣。看 diff 内容。Diff 语义看明白了：把 exact capability 身份从强制改成可选、兼容老五字段。老王我现在读完整文件核实每个验收点，别被 diff 的表面功夫骗了。CI 两个 job 都 pin 到 `bc067cbc...` 了，lint job 本来就不带 ecos。现在老王我核对测试覆盖（partial 拒绝、digest/replay fail-closed 的测试还在不在），同时确认没有旧 SHA 残留。测试覆盖核实：digest mismatch 拒绝测试在（`workflow_dispatch.py` 的 fail-closed 路径），no-double dispatch 在。但艹，任务点名的 "partial exact identity"（六字段：只带一个 exact 字段）没看到专门测试——老王我不猜，直接在 /tmp 快照上实测验证。先建快照（照上轮 gate 的规矩：`git archive HEAD + staged patch`，workspace 一根毛都不动）。艹，`rm -rf` 被闸门拦了。行，老王我换个思路——不用删目录，直接建个全新的带时间戳目录，一样干净。快照与 staged 完全一致。老王我先看测试 helper 构造探针，同时把 CI 等价测试挂后台跑起来（这玩意儿要拉依赖，得几分钟）。Helper 摸清了。老王我现在干两件事并行：(1) 写一个探针测试（只放 /tmp 快照，验证 partial-exact 六字段被拒 + 五字段通过 + 错 digest 拒绝 + 非法 requirements 拒绝）；(2) 挂 CI 等价全量测试后台跑。先发个心跳。探针就位。现在两个后台任务并行挂起：探针测试 + CI 等价全量（探针文件要 `--ignore` 排除，别污染 155 的计数）。等待期间老王不闲着：核对 `admit_workflow` 里 identity 合并路径的完整性、跑一下 CI lint 等价的 ruff 检查（反正快）。Ruff 过了，探针也跑完了（exit 0）。看探针结果，全量还在跑。探针 5/5 全绿：partial 两种姿势都被拒、五字段通过且落盘、错 digest 拒绝、非法 requirements 拒绝。行为验证点全部实证。等全量结果的同时，老王自查一下 workspace 只读合规。Workspace 干净得很——还是原来那三个 staged 文件，HEAD 纹丝没动，老王我一根毛都没碰。等全量测试的时间发个心跳。输出文件还没落盘，uv 大概率还在拉依赖。老王等一会儿再查。艹，全量跑出 `9 failed, 1848 passed`——但等等，任务说的是 "targeted+dogfood = 155 passed"，根本不是全量数字。那 9 个失败也是 `test_resident_decision.py` 的，跟 staged 三文件八竿子打不着。老王先查上轮 gate 的报告（project memory 里提过 `/tmp/gate-report-t1-12-omo-task2.md`）找确切命令，再看看 "dogfood" 是个什么鬼。上轮 gate 报告翻出来了：上轮 "targeted" 跑法 = 153 passed（base 140 + 13 新增），而且 `tests/test_workflow_mesh_task_dogfood.py` 就是 "dogfood"。老王现在数一下候选测试文件的 case 数，凑出 155 的确切集合，同时验证那 9 个 resident 失败是不是本来就有的（与本 staged 无关）。函数计数出来了但 parametrize 会展开，老王直接用 `--collect-only` 数精确数字（staged 快照 + base 快照各一遍，顺带把 resident 失败的预存在性也验了）。艹，收集报错是依赖没给全（少了 httpx/openai/fastmcp/ecos）。上轮 gate 环境是 `--with pytest,pytest-asyncio,pydantic,pyyaml`，但那可能只是简写。老王用全套依赖重新 collect。**155 tests collected** —— 乖乖，分毫不差！targeted（orchestration_contract + blueprint_control + workflow_dispatch）+ dogfood（test_workflow_mesh_task_dogfood.py）正好 155。现在正式跑这个集合，同时验 base 快照上 resident 那批失败是不是老毛病。**155 passed in 12.62s**，零失败零跳过——验证点 5 拿下！base 快照上 resident 那批同样失败（`PermissionError: '/private/.omo'`，环境性根目录探测问题），说明是老毛病不是 staged 引入的。老王再确认一下全量那 9 个失败的具体清单，别放走任何混进来的。9 个失败清一色 resident 子系统（daemon 5 + decision 4），与 staged 三文件零交集。老王补个 base 侧 daemon 验证坐实“预存在”，然后收工。实锤了——base 快照同样 5 failed，9 个失败 100% 预存在环境问题（`/private/.omo` 根目录探测），与 staged 无关。所有验收点全绿，老王写终版报告然后交差。只读合规终检通过，workspace 纹丝未动。交差。🧠 MEMORY: C (5/8 fresh) · due: TELOS.md (review overdue) · last curation +1 new → principal 3h ago
